authorization: User selected cohort adaptation after reviewing evidence that infant-directed vocal behavior has shared cross-cultural tendencies and community- and language-related variation.
research_question: Can label-free alignment to the acoustic transition geometry of a new multi-speaker fieldsite rescue the frozen predictive register model without supervised site tuning?

scientific_basis.citation: Sun, Feng, and Saenko (2016), Return of Frustratingly Easy Domain Adaptation, AAAI 30(1)
scientific_basis.scope: CORAL supports aligning unlabeled source and target second-order statistics. Applying it to prosodic transition rows and interpreting a fieldsite as a relational cohort are project hypotheses, not claims made by that paper.

frozen_alignment.input: The parent model's speaker-and-vocal-mode normalized five-dimensional states, represented as ten-dimensional rows [x[t-1], x[t]].
frozen_alignment.grouping: Estimate a separate transform for speech and song. Vocal mode is known to the batch; IDS/ADS labels are hidden.
frozen_alignment.source_reference: Pool eligible transition rows for the applicable vocal mode from all training fieldsites in the leave-one-fieldsite-out fold.
frozen_alignment.target_reference: Pool eligible transition rows for the same vocal mode from every available speaker in the held-out fieldsite, without using IDS/ADS labels.
frozen_alignment.covariance: Sample covariance shrunk as 0.9*C + 0.1*diag(diag(C)), then symmetrically eigendecomposed with every eigenvalue floored at 0.0001.
frozen_alignment.transform: Map target rows into source geometry as (row - target_mean) * target_covariance^(-1/2) * source_covariance^(1/2) + source_mean.
frozen_alignment.scoring: Split each transformed row into previous and current five-dimensional states and score the pair directly under the four frozen training-fieldsite linear-Gaussian dynamics. Average transition log likelihood per clip.

eligibility.rule: A target fieldsite must contain at least three distinct speakers. Each evaluated clip must retain the parent model's minimum two observations in its speaker-and-mode calibration group.

expected_ineligible_development_fieldsit.ARA: Only one speaker is present in the spent subset.

eligibility.absent_mode_policy: A fieldsite with no clips for a vocal mode is evaluated only on its present mode. No target examples or controls are fabricated.

development_data.source: The exact hash-pinned 200 already-spent clips used by the parent predictive experiment.
development_data.evaluation: Leave one eligible fieldsite out. The held-out fieldsite's unlabeled acoustic transitions enter only its mode-specific alignment transform; its IDS/ADS labels enter evaluation only after predictions are formed.

thresholds.primary: Report the parent zero score thresholds.
thresholds.secondary: Select one speech and one IDS cutoff from eligible leave-one-fieldsite-out predictions, maximizing pooled F1 subject to the frozen pooled-FPR and song-FPR ceilings, then minimum fieldsite F1, then lower error rates.
thresholds.no_target_label_tuning: Target labels do not influence transforms, dynamics, features, frames, covariance settings, eligibility, or per-fieldsite thresholds.

non_pristine_fieldsite.WEL: Previously accessed by the H2 experiment; it cannot supply pristine confirmation.

confirmation_boundary.policy: Do not fetch or inspect USD or TOR archive members, waveforms, headers, hashes, labels, participant lists, or selected filenames unless the complete development implementation, artifact, thresholds, gates, and stop decision are committed first.
confirmation_boundary.prospective_design_if_development_passes: Write a separate transductive batch-confirmation preregistration. Align each new cohort using its unlabeled known-mode batch, commit predictions, and reveal IDS/ADS labels only afterward.

candidate_ready_rule: The ceiling-constrained eligible-fieldsite threshold selection must satisfy every acceptance criterion before a USD/TOR confirmation protocol is written.
stop_rule: If this frozen alignment fails development readiness, retain the failure and do not tune shrinkage, eigenvalue floor, frame size, feature list, dynamics order, normalization scope, eligibility, grouping, or thresholds into another attempt. Another mechanism requires a new explicit research decision.
claim_boundary: A pass would support a transparent, transductive detector that acclimates to a fieldsite cohort of at least three speakers when vocal-mode grouping is known. It would not establish cold-start, causal, per-speaker, raw-clip, universal, semantic, infant-learning, or biological detection.
